body.title: Attachment store
body.summary: New vscode-plugin/src/chat/attachment-store.ts: AttachmentRef, the AttachmentFs seam with its node implementation, AttachmentRefused, createAttachmentStore (dirOf, addBytes, addFile, remove, removeSession, sweep) and the three limits as recorded by the user: MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES 20 MiB, MAX_ATTACHMENTS_PER_MESSAGE 10, PASTE_IMAGE_MIMES png/jpeg/gif/webp. Files go to `<root>/<sessionFileName(id)>/<n>-<safe name>`; a picked document is copied. Nothing uses it yet.
acceptanceChecks: addBytes and addFile write into the session's own directory under a safe numbered name and return id, original name, kind, size and path
An oversize paste or file, a mime outside the image list and a source that is not a regular file are refused with AttachmentRefused and nothing is written; a failed write leaves no partial file
remove ignores an id that is not a plain file name in the session's directory; remove and removeSession succeed when the target is gone
sweep removes only directories of sessions not kept whose files are all older than the age
The limits are the recorded constants
